changes: Give each map observation one keyboard-focusable button with camera-specific accessible name and selected state; a transparent 24-pixel non-scaling stroke enlarges its hit target without enlarging the visible marker.
Accept only a primary left-button map drag, retain its pointer identity, ignore other pointers, and clear dragging on cancel, capture loss or reset.
Describe shared IDs as supplied identities without claiming camera observations are deduplicated or fused.
Preserve polygon points when changing between polygon rule types; clear points only when changing camera or geometry family.
Disable editor value changes, undo, reverse, edit and delete actions while saving; keep Close available. Workspace separately protects draft generations and blocks camera drawing during a save.

Validate camera, name, rule type, selected classes, bounded integer duration/counts, finite normalized points, distinct endpoints, nonzero polygon area, polygon intersections and required movement direction before submission.
Apply orientation tolerance to each cross product rather than their product so small self-crossing polygons are rejected while valid small areas remain accepted.
Explain invalid drafts beside Save, retain empty numeric inputs as invalid rather than silently changing their meaning, and memoize validation across camera-only renders.
Reset delete confirmation when the edited rule or camera changes.
Shared CSS also includes the earlier map-legend contrast backplate, evidence hierarchy and unknown-rule reason styling from this source-only pass.
